title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 18
description: Ten questions on Exodus 18: Jethro's visit to Moses and his advice to appoint judges over the people.

questions.explanation: Jethro was the priest of Midian, Moses' father-in-law.

questions.text: What was the name of Moses' wife?
questions.explanation: Jethro received Zipporah, Moses' wife, after he had sent her away.

questions.text: Why was Moses' son named Gershom?
questions.explanation: Moses said: 'I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land.'

answers.text: God had made Moses forget his trouble
Moses had lived as a foreigner in a foreign land
Moses had found a home in Midian

questions.text: What was the name of Moses' other son?
questions.explanation: The other son was named Eliezer, for Moses said: 'My father's God was my help and delivered me from Pharaoh's sword.'

questions.text: What did Jethro say he now knew?
questions.explanation: Jethro said: 'Now I know that Yahweh is greater than all gods.'

answers.text: That he must go with Israel to Canaan
That Pharaoh would come after them again
That Yahweh is greater than all gods

questions.text: How long did the people stand around Moses while he judged them?
questions.explanation: Moses sat to judge the people, and the people stood around him from the morning to the evening.

answers.text: Only on the Sabbath day each week
From the morning to the evening
One single day in each month
Only during the hours of the night

questions.text: What did Jethro say about Moses judging the people alone?
questions.explanation: Jethro said it was not good: the thing was too heavy for Moses, and he could not do it alone.

answers.text: It was too heavy for him to do alone
It was the best way to rule the people
Aaron should do it in his place
It should only be done on feast days

questions.text: What kind of men did Jethro tell Moses to choose as rulers?
questions.explanation: Jethro said to choose able men who fear God, men of truth, hating unjust gain.

answers.text: The oldest men from every family of Israel
Strong men who were skilled in war and battle
Able men who fear God, men of truth, hating unjust gain
Rich men who owned land in every tribe

questions.text: Over what groups did Moses make the chosen men rulers?
questions.explanation: Moses made them heads over the people: rulers of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties and of tens.

questions.text: Which cases did the rulers bring to Moses?
questions.explanation: They judged the people at all times; the hard cases they brought to Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.
